issues: No sign of getting around the measurement: ion_counts uses fixed SMARTS patterns on the input SMILES only; no test labels, file access or pasted values.

Three changes are bundled (RF trees 200->100, the (lam, wr) grid reduced to the single setting (0.5, 1.0), new ionisable-group count features). A rejection can't tell which change hurt; the ion features alone may still be worth testing on their own.
The single-setting grid leaves the inner GroupKFold selection loop as dead computation: it runs but selects nothing. Not a correctness bug.
ion_counts does not guard against Chem.MolFromSmiles returning None; it would crash on an unreadable SMILES string, but this job ran, so the result is unaffected.

Recomputed z = (0.4895-0.4939)/(0.0042*sqrt(2)) ~= -0.74, consistent with the harness's -0.751 given rounding of the means. With n=1 on each side the difference is about 0.75 sd, so rejecting is correct.
